description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Runtime_Foreach, which provides methods for managing foreach loop runtime behavior in the Smarty templating engine, including initialization, counting, and restoring loop variables.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Runtime_Foreach
classes.description: Class providing runtime methods for foreach loops in Smarty templates, including init, count, and restore functions.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes a foreach loop, saving variables, setting up loop parameters, and counting total items if needed.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Counts elements in various iterable or countable objects, including arrays, Traversable, PDOStatement, etc.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Restores saved loop variables after a loop is broken or continued.
